lines: As many pains as there are
When I have forgotten, they reach my brain
Let the draft of emptiness be forgiven
Even the wings that sprout from my mood
For now I’ll bear them all on my back
I’m not afraid of this sky
Follow the feathers that flutter in the wind
As many words as there are
When you have forgotten, they reach your eyes
Even the wings that faced the headwind
For now I’ll bear them all on my back
I’m not afraid of this sky
To the feathers that sway in the wind
Those gloomy, overgrown rations and retreat
What lies before you isn’t the answer
A gust that wears away the corridor
Even the wings that sprout from my mood
But they are my wings, all of them
I’ll never forget, everything in a row
I’m not afraid, under this night sky
